name: Kansas City Developer Conference
description: Annual multi-day developer conference held in Kansas City. KCDC brings together hundreds of developers across all stacks for two days of sessions, workshops, and networking.

name: KC Tech Council
description: A nonprofit membership organization advocating for Kansas City's technology sector. Works to grow tech talent pipelines, connect businesses, and promote KC as a tech destination.

name: KC Digital Drive
description: A public-private initiative focused on digital equity and expanding broadband access across the Kansas City region. Works to ensure all residents can participate in the digital economy.

name: 1 Million Cups Kansas City
description: A weekly Wednesday morning program where entrepreneurs present their startups and receive feedback from the community. Hosted by the Kauffman Foundation, free and open to all.

name: KC Rising
description: A regional economic development initiative bringing together business, civic, and community leaders to accelerate growth across the Kansas City metro, with a strong emphasis on tech and innovation sectors.

name: KCSourceLink
description: Connects Kansas City entrepreneurs and small business owners to the right resources at the right time. Maintains a network of hundreds of support organizations across the KC metro.

name: DigitalBridge KC
description: A digital skills and workforce development initiative helping Kansas City residents build technology competencies and access careers in the digital economy.

name: KC Next
description: A tech talent attraction and retention initiative working to position Kansas City as a top destination for technology professionals. Formerly part of the KCADC tech arm.

name: Helios
description: A Kansas City-based nonprofit accelerator supporting early-stage entrepreneurs and startups through mentorship, programming, and community connections.

name: Think Big Partners
description: A Kansas City startup accelerator and co-working community offering mentorship, programming, and connections to help tech and innovation-focused companies grow.

name: KC Entrepreneurship Initiative
description: Supports entrepreneurship education and ecosystem development across the Kansas City region, connecting founders with resources, mentors, and each other.

name: Code the Dream
description: Teaches software development skills to people from underrepresented communities, providing a pathway to tech careers. KC chapter offers training and mentorship at no cost to students.

name: Digital Women Kansas City
description: A professional community dedicated to educating and empowering women to succeed in digital fields and beyond. Offers networking events, mentorship, and professional development for women in tech, marketing, and design across the KC metro.

name: LaunchCode
description: A nonprofit offering free coding education and job placement support, with a strong Kansas City presence. Helps people from all backgrounds launch careers in technology.
